context: Tests whether the solution applies the skill's decomposition criteria and constructs deterministic, dependency-complete SwiftUI previews without weakening production contracts.

checklist.name: Keep small fragment
checklist.description: Keeps the short stateless header as a computed some View fragment rather than extracting it solely because the file is long.

checklist.name: Extract activity view
checklist.description: Extracts the activity area into a dedicated View based on meaningful branching or substantial layout.

checklist.name: Lifecycle boundary
checklist.description: Treats the activity area's asynchronous lifecycle or local state as an extraction signal.

checklist.name: Narrow dependencies
checklist.description: Gives the extracted view narrow values and actions or otherwise limits its Observation dependencies instead of passing unrelated store state.

checklist.name: Previewable boundary
checklist.description: Uses independent preview value or clearer parent data flow as a reason for the dedicated View boundary without requiring reuse.

checklist.name: Organization distinction
checklist.description: States that extensions and section markers organize a file but do not replace actual view decomposition.

checklist.name: State coverage
checklist.description: Covers deterministic loaded plus meaningful loading, empty, and error preview states.

checklist.name: Required dependencies
checklist.description: Keeps required production dependencies nonoptional and installs every required environment dependency in the preview composition.

checklist.name: Isolated fixtures
checklist.description: Uses fixed fixtures and isolated in-memory or temporary persistence without live networking, authentication, production databases, keychain state, or global singletons.

checklist.name: Concurrency handoff
checklist.description: Keeps basic task-lifecycle guidance local but routes advanced cancellation, debounce, clocks, AsyncSequence, or actor-isolation details to swift-concurrency.
